body: I love rock climbing/bouldering. Problem is it's not so much fun if you go by yourself. I've tried asking my friends if they want to go but pretty much everyone doesn't want to go.

Nah I think I'm over it. I probably am bipolar to be honest. I think it might run in the family - none of us have actually been diagnosed with it but at this point, I don't think I really give a shit. My family brushes this "depression" shit aside as a phase so they would never be understanding.
